precondition.description: The contractor either supplies explicit search terms and absolute roots with read-only authority, or names one provider-owned recovery and its exact bundle digests for a zero-read bounded projection.

move.description: Search authorized path names and file contents, or project an already-settled provider recovery without rereading source territory; rank bounded candidates, preserve source digests and ownership evidence, and report omissions without changing customer territory.
move.domain: ActivityStreams Accept of one provider-authored recovery offer
move.codomain: ContextualBundle plus GapBundle or explicit refusal

postcondition.description: Every admitted source names its path, digest, ownership evidence, status, matching terms, and bounded snippets; truncation, unreadable files, and unmatched terms remain explicit gaps; a projection names and verifies its source recovery and performs zero source-territory reads; customer territory is unchanged.
